editorial:
Imagine being the best at a job you actually hate. That is exactly where you find Mary. She is a high-level hit woman for a scary crime family in Boston, but she is tired of the killing and the lies. The vibe is dark and tense, but everything changes when a job goes wrong and she meets a sweet little boy. This small connection sparks something inside her, making her want to leave her violent life behind for good. It is a classic story of redemption, but with a lot of guns and fast cars to keep things moving.

Taraji P. Henson does a great job showing the struggle between being a cold killer and a caring person. The action scenes are punchy and easy to follow, though some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable. If you like movies where a dangerous person tries to do the right thing, you will love this.
endingExplained: After a lot of fighting, Mary takes on her former bosses to protect the boy and herself. She manages to outsmart the crime family and takes down the main villains in a final showdown. By the end, Mary finally breaks free from the organization that controlled her life. She finds a sense of peace and starts a new life, knowing she is no longer a tool for killers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strong female leads and high-stakes crime thrillers.
